annotations.title: Interactive climate risk and weather map

description:
Shows an interactive map in clients that render apps (Claude, ChatGPT): this week's forecast risk, hazard events and official warnings for a place, several places side by side, one event (its area, a storm's cone and track) or the whole world; layer opens it on rain, temperature or wind instead. A client without apps gets a text summary and a link.

Use it when the user wants to see a place, a storm or the world on a map.

PlaceGiven.description: One place, by its name or its coordinates.

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

event_id.description: An event's id from list_hazards or get_hazards_near, for the map of that event

focus.description: What a place's map shows: this week's forecast risk, the hazard events nearby, or both; an event's map leaves the events around it out for week

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

layer.description: The forecast field the map opens on, under the hazard events: the risk (default), or the precipitation, temperature or wind forecast when the question is about the weather itself. The reader can switch between them on the map

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

places.description: 2 to 10 places to set side by side, each a place_name or latitude and longitude

name: show_risk_map

days.description: This week's forecast risk by day; null where there is none

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

hazard.description: The hazard that holds most of them then

level.description: The day's forecast risk class; null when no step of it is graded

country.description: The country the place lies in; null at sea

name.description: The place name the map is labelled with; null when coordinates were given

countries.description: The world's map: the countries this week's forecast puts most people at risk in

criora_url.description: The map on Criora's own site

days.description: The place's forecast risk by day this week

event.description: The event the map is of

events_total.description: Hazard events found around the place or the event, or in force in the world

layer.description: The forecast field the map opens on: risk, precipitation, temperature or wind

place.description: The place the map is of; null for another subject

places.description: The places side by side, as asked

radius_km.description: How far the search for events reached

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

subject.description: What the map is of: a place, the world, one event, or several places side by side
